files.author: Bilig
modifications: no free leaf cross-section model was found (CGTrader: paid royalty-free; BioRender: login-gated template; the rest are physical teaching models), so the block diagram is authored by the pipeline script

dicot leaf block, top to bottom: Cuticle, Epidermis_Upper, palisade mesophyll (55 columnar cells with chloroplasts along the walls), spongy mesophyll (loose cells, air spaces), Epidermis_Lower with 4 stomata (GuardCell_*a/b around Stoma_* = pore + substomatal air chamber), Cuticle
every mesophyll cell's chloroplasts are in Chloro_<cell>, their grana (thylakoid stacks, chlorophyll) in Thylakoid_<cell>
decorative, unnamed: the vein (bundle sheath, xylem, phloem)
the topic's stoma, mesophyll and chloroplast anchors sit on real parts; colours from the concept hues (hsl(h, 62%, 62%))
gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation; KHR_materials_clearcoat

nodes: Palisade_1…55, Chloro_P1…P55, Thylakoid_P1…P55 (one per palisade cell)
Spongy_1…n, Chloro_S1…Sn, Thylakoid_S1…Sn (one per spongy cell)
